name: @muxos/plugin-apps-website-app-tiles
description: The website's app tiles: the vivid colours an app wears on muxos.ai (WebsiteTileColor — 19 hues and slate, in OKLCH) and <WebsiteAppTile>, the app's glyph on its colour as a deep-to-base diagonal gradient on a bounded squircle. The site's own look; muxos's launchers draw apps-core/app-icon's tile.
